name: inspect_alert_everyday
label: Alert Statistics for Inspection
description: The inspection alert statistics table can be used for related queries in inspection-related reporting scenarios.

fields.name: report_time
fields.description: Inspection time, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: resource_id
fields.description: Asset ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: alert_level
fields.description: Alert level. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: alert_object
fields.description: Alert object, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the resource_id, report_time, alert_object fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_alertlevel
indexes.description: Standard index covering the alert_level field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
